name: B10-0277/2025 – § 9 – Am 42
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: 9. Stresses the role of electrification, but notes that significant expansion and modernisation of grids are necessary; calls for an ‘EU strategy on energy flexibility’ with a focus on demand-side response and energy storage; remains concerned by the priority of dispatch of intermittent renewable energies, which may increase the risk of blackouts, particularly in the event of excess electricity supply in relation to demand; acknowledges that the growing share of wind and solar photovoltaic capacities puts more pressure on grid operators to maintain a stable and constant supply in the electricity grids, thus compromising the overall stability of the grids; welcomes the intention to update the Heating and Cooling Strategy and Electrification Action Plan; calls on the Commission to recognise the energy efficiency sector as a key strategic sector for industrial decarbonisation and European competitiveness;
